sentences.en: Sadly, in the next 18 minutes when I do our chat, four Americans that are alive will be dead through the food that they eat.
sentences.zh: 可悲的是，在接下来的 18 分钟内，当我进行聊天时，四个活着的美国人将因他们所吃的食物而死亡。

sentences.en: My name's Jamie Oliver. I'm 34 years old.
sentences.zh: 我叫杰米·奥利弗。我今年34岁了。

sentences.en: I'm from Essex in England and for the last seven years I've worked fairly tirelessly to save lives in my own way.
sentences.zh: 我来自英国埃塞克斯，在过去的七年里，我不知疲倦地以自己的方式拯救生命。

sentences.en: I'm not a doctor; I'm a chef, I don't have expensive equipment or medicine.
sentences.zh: 我不是医生；我是一名厨师，我没有昂贵的设备或药品。

sentences.en: I use information, education. I profoundly believe that the power of food has a primal place in our homes that binds us to the best bits of life.
sentences.zh: 我使用信息、教育。我坚信食物的力量在我们的家庭中占有重要地位，它将我们与生活中最美好的部分联系在一起。

sentences.en: We have an awful, awful reality right now.
sentences.zh: 我们现在面临着一个非常非常可怕的现实。

sentences.en: America, you're at the top of your game.
sentences.zh: 美国，你正处于游戏的顶端。

sentences.en: This is one of the most unhealthy countries in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是世界上最不健康的国家之一。

sentences.en: Can I please just see a raise of hands for how many of you have children in this room today?
sentences.zh: 今天在座的各位有多少人有孩子，请举手好吗？

sentences.en: Put your hands up. You can continue to put your hands up, aunties and uncles as well.
sentences.zh: 请举起双手。叔叔阿姨们也可以继续举手。

sentences.en: Most of you. OK. We, the adults of the last four generations, have blessed our children with the destiny of a shorter lifespan than their own parents.
sentences.zh: 你们大多数人。好的。我们，过去四代的成年人，祝福我们的孩子比他们自己的父母寿命更短的命运。

sentences.en: Your child will live a life ten years younger than you because of the landscape of food that we've built around them.
sentences.zh: 由于我们为您的孩子打造了美食景观，您的孩子将比您年轻十岁。

sentences.en: Two-thirds of this room, today, in America, are statistically overweight or obese.
sentences.zh: 今天，在美国，这个房间里三分之二的人据统计超重或肥胖。

sentences.en: You lot, you're all right, but we'll get you eventually, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 你们，你们没事，但我们最终会找到你们的，别担心。

sentences.en: (Laughter) The statistics of bad health are clear, very clear.
sentences.zh: （笑声）健康状况不佳的统计数据很清楚，非常清楚。

sentences.en: We spend our lives being paranoid about death, murder, homicide, you name it; it's on the front page of every paper, CNN.
sentences.zh: 我们一生都对死亡、谋杀、凶杀等偏执，凡是你能想到的；它出现在每份报纸的头版，CNN。

sentences.en: Look at homicide at the bottom, for God's sake.
sentences.zh: 看在上帝的份上，看看底层的凶杀案。

sentences.en: Right? (Laughter) (Applause) Every single one of those in the red is a diet-related disease.
sentences.zh: 正确的？ （笑声）（掌声）每一个红色的都是与饮食有关的疾病。

sentences.en: Any doctor, any specialist will tell you that.
sentences.zh: 任何医生、任何专家都会告诉你这一点。

sentences.en: Fact: diet-related disease is the biggest killer in the United States, right now, here today.
sentences.zh: 事实：与饮食相关的疾病是美国最大的杀手，此时此刻，就在今天。

sentences.en: This is a global problem. It's a catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全球性问题。这是一场灾难。

sentences.en: It's sweeping the world. England is right behind you, as usual.
sentences.zh: 它正在席卷全球。像往常一样，英格兰就在你身后。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I know they were close, but not that close.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我知道他们很接近，但不是那么接近。

sentences.en: We need a revolution. Mexico, Australia, Germany, India, China, all have massive problems of obesity and bad health.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一场革命。墨西哥、澳大利亚、德国、印度、中国都存在严重的肥胖和健康问题。

sentences.en: Think about smoking. It costs way less than obesity now.
sentences.zh: 想想抽烟吧。现在它的成本比肥胖要低得多。

sentences.en: Obesity costs you Americans 10 percent of your health-care bills, 150 billion dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 美国人因肥胖而花费的医疗费用占医疗费用的 10%，即每年 1500 亿美元。

sentences.en: In 10 years, it's set to double: 300 billion dollars a year.
sentences.zh: 10 年内，这一数字将翻一番：每年 3000 亿美元。

sentences.en: Let's be honest, guys, you haven't got that cash.
sentences.zh: 老实说，伙计们，你们没有那么多现金。

sentences.en: (Laughter) I came here to start a food revolution that I so profoundly believe in.
sentences.zh: （笑声）我来这里是为了发起一场我坚信的食品革命。

sentences.en: We need it. The time is now. We're in a tipping-point moment.
sentences.zh: 我们需要它。现在是时候了。我们正处于一个转折点。

sentences.en: I've been doing this for seven years. I've been trying in America for seven years.
sentences.zh: 我这样做已经七年了。我在美国已经尝试了七年。

sentences.en: Now is the time when it's ripe -- ripe for the picking.
sentences.zh: 现在正是成熟的时候——成熟了，可以采摘了。

sentences.en: I went to the eye of the storm. I went to West Virginia, the most unhealthy state in America.
sentences.zh: 我去了风暴眼。我去了西弗吉尼亚州，美国最不健康的州。

sentences.en: Or it was last year. We've got a new one this year, but we'll work on that next season.
sentences.zh: 或者说是去年的事了。今年我们有了一个新的，但我们会在下个赛季继续努力。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Huntington, West Virginia. Beautiful town.
sentences.zh: （笑声）西弗吉尼亚州亨廷顿。美丽的小镇。

sentences.en: I wanted to put heart and soul and people, your public, around the statistics that we've become so used to.
sentences.zh: 我想全心全意地关注我们已经习以为常的统计数据。

sentences.en: I want to introduce you to some of the people that I care about: your public, your children.
sentences.zh: 我想向您介绍一些我关心的人：您的公众、您的孩子。

sentences.en: I want to show a picture of my friend Brittany.
sentences.zh: 我想展示我朋友布列塔尼的照片。

sentences.en: She's 16 years old. She's got six years to live because of the food that she's eaten.
sentences.zh: 她今年 16 岁。由于她所吃的食物，她还能活六年。

sentences.en: She's the third generation of Americans that hasn't grown up within a food environment where they've been taught to cook at home or in school, or her mom, or her mom's mom.
sentences.zh: 她是第三代美国人，他们没有在家里或学校、她的妈妈或她妈妈的妈妈的食物环境中长大。

sentences.en: She has six years to live. She's eating her liver to death.
sentences.zh: 她还有六年的寿命。她正在吃她的肝脏。

sentences.en: Stacy, the Edwards family. This is a normal family, guys.
sentences.zh: 史黛西，爱德华兹一家。这是一个正常的家庭，伙计们。

sentences.en: Stacy does her best, but she's third-generation as well; she was never taught to cook at home or at school.
sentences.zh: 史黛西尽了最大努力，但她也是第三代；她在家里或学校从未被教过做饭。

sentences.en: The family's obese. Justin here, 12 years old, he's 350 pounds.
sentences.zh: 一家人都胖了贾斯汀，12 岁，体重 350 磅。

sentences.en: He gets bullied, for God's sake. The daughter there, Katie, she's four years old.
sentences.zh: 看在上帝的份上，他被欺负了。那里的女儿凯蒂，四岁了。

sentences.en: She's obese before she even gets to primary school.
sentences.zh: 她还没上小学就已经肥胖了。

sentences.en: Marissa, she's all right, she's one of your lot.
sentences.zh: 玛丽莎，她很好，她是你的一员。

sentences.en: But you know what? Her father, who was obese, died in her arms, And then the second most important man in her life, her uncle, died of obesity, and now her step-dad is obese.
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？她肥胖的父亲死在了她怀里，然后她生命中第二重要的男人叔叔也因肥胖去世，现在她的继父也肥胖了。

sentences.en: You see, the thing is, obesity and diet-related disease doesn't just hurt the people that have it; it's all of their friends, families, brothers, sisters.
sentences.zh: 你看，事实是，肥胖和与饮食相关的疾病不仅会伤害患有这些疾病的人，还会伤害他们。这是他们所有的朋友、家人、兄弟、姐妹。

sentences.en: Pastor Steve: an inspirational man, one of my early allies in Huntington, West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫牧师：一位鼓舞人心的人，我在西弗吉尼亚州亨廷顿的早期盟友之一。

sentences.en: He's at the sharp knife-edge of this problem.
sentences.zh: 他正处于这个问题的最尖锐的边缘。

sentences.en: He has to bury the people, OK? And he's fed up with it.
sentences.zh: 他必须把人埋葬，好吗？他已经受够了。

sentences.en: He's fed up with burying his friends, his family, his community.
sentences.zh: 他厌倦了埋葬他的朋友、家人和社区。

sentences.en: Come winter, three times as many people die.
sentences.zh: 冬天来了，死亡人数是原来的三倍。

sentences.en: He's sick of it. This is preventable disease. Waste of life.
sentences.zh: 他受够了。这是可以预防的疾病。浪费生命。

sentences.en: By the way, this is what they get buried in.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这就是他们被埋葬的地方。

sentences.en: We're not geared up to do this. Can't even get them out the door, and I'm being serious.
sentences.zh: 我们还没有准备好这样做。甚至不能把他们赶出家门，我是认真的。

sentences.en: Can't even get them there. Forklift. OK, I see it as a triangle, OK?
sentences.zh: 甚至无法让他们到达那里。叉车。好吧，我看它是一个三角形，好吗？

sentences.en: This is our landscape of food. I need you to understand it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们的美食风景。我需要你理解它。

sentences.en: You've probably heard all this before. Over the last 30 years, what's happened that's ripped the heart out of this country?
sentences.zh: 您以前可能已经听说过这一切。过去30年里，发生了什么让这个国家心碎的事情？

sentences.en: Let's be frank and honest. Well, modern-day life.
sentences.zh: 让我们坦率和诚实。嗯，现代生活。

sentences.en: Let's start with the Main Street. Fast food has taken over the whole country; we know that.
sentences.zh: 我们先从主街开始吧。快餐已经风靡全国；我们知道这一点。

sentences.en: The big brands are some of the most important powers, powerful powers, in this country.
sentences.zh: 大品牌是这个国家最重要的力量、最强大的力量。

sentences.en: (Sighs) Supermarkets as well. Big companies. Big companies.
sentences.zh: （叹气）超市也是如此。大公司。大公司。

sentences.en: Thirty years ago, most of the food was largely local and largely fresh.
sentences.zh: 三十年前，大部分食物主要是本地的，而且大多是新鲜的。

sentences.en: Now it's largely processed and full of all sorts of additives, extra ingredients, and you know the rest of the story.
sentences.zh: 现在它已经经过大量加工，充满了各种添加剂、额外成分，剩下的故事你都知道了。

sentences.en: Portion size is obviously a massive, massive problem.
sentences.zh: 份量显然是一个非常非常大的问题。

sentences.en: Labeling is a massive problem. The labeling in this country is a disgrace.
sentences.zh: 标签是一个大问题。在这个国家，标签是一种耻辱。

sentences.en: The industry wants to self-police themselves.
sentences.zh: 该行业希望自我监管。

sentences.en: What, in this kind of climate? They don't deserve it.
sentences.zh: 什么，在这种气候下？他们不值得。

sentences.en: How can you say something is low-fat when it's full of so much sugar?
sentences.zh: 当某样东西含有这么多糖时，你怎么能说它是低脂的呢？

sentences.en: Home. The biggest problem with the home is that used to be the heart of passing on food culture, what made our society.
sentences.zh: 家。家庭最大的问题是，它曾经是传承饮食文化的核心，也是我们社会的基础。

sentences.en: That is not happening anymore. And you know, as we go to work and as life changes, and as life always evolves, we kind of have to look at it holistically -- step back for a moment, and re-address the balance.
sentences.zh: 这种情况不再发生了。你知道，当我们开始工作、生活发生变化、生活总是在发展时，我们必须从整体上看待它——退后一步，重新解决平衡问题。

sentences.en: It hasn't happened for 30 years, OK? I want to show you a situation that is very normal right now; the Edwards family.
sentences.zh: 这样的事已经30年没有发生过了，好吗？我想给大家展示一个现在很正常的情况；爱德华兹家族。

sentences.en: (Video) Jamie Oliver: Let's have a talk.
sentences.zh: （视频）杰米·奥利弗：我们来谈谈吧。

sentences.en: This stuff goes through you and your family's body every week.
sentences.zh: 这些东西每周都会经过你和你家人的身体。

sentences.en: And I need you to know that this is going to kill your children early.
sentences.zh: 我需要你知道这会提前杀死你的孩子。

sentences.en: How are you feeling? Stacy: Just feeling really sad and depressed right now.
sentences.zh: 你感觉怎么样？史黛西：现在感到非常悲伤和沮丧。

sentences.en: But, you know, I want my kids to succeed in life and this isn't going to get them there.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，我希望我的孩子们在生活中取得成功，但这并不能让他们实现这一目标。

sentences.en: But I'm killing them. JO: Yes you are. You are.
sentences.zh: 但我要杀了他们。乔：是的，你是。你是。

sentences.en: But we can stop that. Normal. Let's get on schools, something that I'm fairly much a specialist in.
sentences.zh: 但我们可以阻止这种情况。普通的。让我们谈谈学校吧，我在这方面相当专家。

sentences.en: OK, school. What is school? Who invented it? What's the purpose of school?
sentences.zh: 好的，学校。什么是学校？谁发明的？学校的目的是什么？

sentences.en: School was always invented to arm us with the tools to make us creative, do wonderful things, make us earn a living, etc., etc.
sentences.zh: 学校的发明总是为了给我们提供工具，让我们发挥创造力，做精彩的事情，让我们谋生等等。

sentences.en: You know, it's been kind of in this sort of tight box for a long, long time, OK?
sentences.zh: 你知道，它已经在这种狭小的盒子里待了很长很长一段时间了，好吗？

sentences.en: But we haven't really evolved it to deal with the health catastrophes of America, OK?
sentences.zh: 但我们还没有真正发展它来应对美国的健康灾难，好吗？

sentences.en: School food is something that most kids -- 31 million a day, actually -- have twice a day, more than often, breakfast and lunch, 180 days of the year.
sentences.zh: 学校伙食是大多数孩子（实际上每天有 3100 万）每天吃两次早餐和午餐的食物，而且一年中 180 天都是如此。

sentences.en: So you could say that school food is quite important, really, judging the circumstances.
sentences.zh: 因此，根据具体情况，你可以说学校伙食确实非常重要。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Before I crack into my rant, which I'm sure you're waiting for -- (Laughter)
sentences.zh: （笑声）在我开始咆哮之前，我相信你们正在等待——（笑声）

sentences.en: I need to say one thing, and it's so important in, hopefully, the magic that happens and unfolds in the next three months.
sentences.zh: 我需要说一件事，希望这对于未来三个月内发生和展开的魔力来说非常重要。

sentences.en: The lunch ladies, the lunch cooks of America -- I offer myself as their ambassador.
sentences.zh: 美国的午餐女士、午餐厨师——我愿意担任他们的大使。

sentences.en: I'm not slagging them off. They're doing the best they can do.
sentences.zh: 我不会贬低他们。他们正在尽力而为。

sentences.en: They're doing their best. But they're doing what they're told, and what they're being told to do is wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们正在尽力而为。但他们正在做他们被告知的事情，而他们被告知做的事情是错误的。

sentences.en: The system is highly run by accountants; there's not enough, or any, food-knowledgeable people in the business.
sentences.zh: 该系统由会计师高度运作；该行业缺乏足够的食品知识人员，或者没有足够的食品知识人员。

sentences.en: There's a problem: If you're not a food expert, and you've got tight budgets and it's getting tighter, then you can't be creative, you can't duck and dive and write different things around things.
sentences.zh: 有一个问题：如果你不是食品专家，而且你的预算很紧张，而且预算越来越紧，那么你就无法发挥创造力，你就无法潜入水中，围绕事物写出不同的东西。

sentences.en: If you're an accountant, and a box-ticker, the only thing you can do in these circumstances is buy cheaper shit.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一名会计师，并且是一名记账员，在这种情况下你唯一能做的就是买更便宜的东西。

sentences.en: Now, the reality is, the food that your kids get every day is fast food, it's highly processed, there's not enough fresh food in there at all.
sentences.zh: 现在的现实是，你的孩子每天吃的食物都是快餐，经过高度加工，里面根本没有足够的新鲜食物。

sentences.en: You know, the amount of additives, E numbers, ingredients you wouldn't believe -- there's not enough veggies at all.
sentences.zh: 你知道，添加剂的数量、E 数字、成分的数量你都不敢相信——根本没有足够的蔬菜。

sentences.en: French fries are considered a vegetable.
sentences.zh: 炸薯条被认为是一种蔬菜。

sentences.en: Pizza for breakfast. They don't even get crockery.
sentences.zh: 早餐吃披萨。他们甚至连陶器都拿不到。

sentences.en: Knives and forks? No, they're too dangerous.
sentences.zh: 刀子和叉子？不，他们太危险了。

sentences.en: They have scissors in the classroom, but knives and forks? No.
sentences.zh: 教室里有剪刀，但是刀叉呢？不。

sentences.en: And the way I look at it is: If you don't have knives and forks in your school, you're purely endorsing, from a state level, fast food, because it's handheld.
sentences.zh: 我的看法是：如果你的学校没有刀叉，那么你纯粹是从州一级支持快餐，因为它是手持式的。

sentences.en: And yes, by the way, it is fast food: It's sloppy Joes, it's burgers, it's wieners, it's pizzas, it's all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 是的，顺便说一句，它是快餐：它是马虎乔，它是汉堡，它是维也纳，它是披萨，它是所有这些东西。

sentences.en: (Sighs) Ten percent of what we spend on health care, as I said earlier, is on obesity, and it's going to double.
sentences.zh: （叹气）正如我之前所说，我们在医疗保健上花费的百分之十是用于肥胖的，而且这个数字还会增加一倍。

sentences.en: We're not teaching our kids. There's no statutory right to teach kids about food, elementary or secondary school, OK?
sentences.zh: 我们不是在教我们的孩子。没有法定权利教孩子们关于食物的知识，无论是小学还是中学，好吗？

sentences.en: We don't teach kids about food, right? And this is a little clip from an elementary school, which is very common in England.
sentences.zh: 我们不教孩子关于食物的知识，对吗？这是来自小学的一个小片段，这在英国很常见。

sentences.en: (Video) Who knows what this is? Child: Potatoes.
sentences.zh: （视频）谁知道这是什么？孩子：土豆。

sentences.en: Jamie Oliver: Potato? So, you think these are potatoes?
sentences.zh: 杰米·奥利弗：土豆？那么，你认为这些是土豆吗？

sentences.en: Do you know what that is? Do you know what that is?
sentences.zh: 你知道那是什么吗？你知道那是什么吗？

sentences.en: Child: Broccoli? JO: What about this? Our good old friend.
sentences.zh: 孩子：西兰花？乔：那这个呢？我们的好老朋友。

sentences.en: Child: Celery. JO: No. What do you think this is?
sentences.zh: 孩子：芹菜。 JO：不，你认为这是什么？

sentences.en: Child: Onion. JO: Onion? No. JO: Immediately you get a really clear sense of "Do the kids know anything about where food comes from?"
sentences.zh: 孩子：洋葱。乔：洋葱？ JO：你立刻就会清楚地意识到“孩子们知道食物从哪里来吗？”

sentences.en: Who knows what that is? Child: Uh, pear?
sentences.zh: 谁知道那是什么？孩子：呃，梨子？

sentences.en: JO: What do you think this is? Child: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 乔：你认为这是什么？孩子：我不知道。

sentences.en: JO: If the kids don't know what stuff is, then they will never eat it.
sentences.zh: JO：如果孩子们不知道东西是什么，那么他们就永远不会吃它。

sentences.en: (Laughter) JO: Normal. England and America, England and America.
sentences.zh: （笑声） JO：正常。英国和美国，英国和美国。

sentences.en: Guess what fixed that. Two one-hour sessions.
sentences.zh: 猜猜是什么解决了这个问题。两次一小时的课程。

sentences.en: We've got to start teaching our kids about food in schools, period.
sentences.zh: 我们必须开始在学校教我们的孩子关于食物的知识。

sentences.en: (Applause) I want to tell you about something that kind of epitomizes the trouble that we're in, guys, OK?
sentences.zh: （掌声）我想告诉你们一些可以概括我们所面临的麻烦的事情，伙计们，好吗？

sentences.en: I want to talk about something so basic as milk.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈像牛奶这样基本的东西。

sentences.en: Every kid has the right to milk at school.
sentences.zh: 每个孩子都有权在学校喝牛奶。

sentences.en: Your kids will be having milk at school, breakfast and lunch, right?
sentences.zh: 您的孩子会在学校喝牛奶、早餐和午餐，对吧？

sentences.en: They'll be having two bottles, OK? And most kids do.
sentences.zh: 他们要两瓶，好吗？大多数孩子都会这样做。

sentences.en: But milk ain't good enough anymore. Don't get me wrong, I support milk -- but someone at the milk board probably paid a lot of money for some geezer to work out that if you put loads of flavorings, colorings and sugar in milk,
sentences.zh: 但牛奶已经不够好了。别误会我的意思，我支持牛奶——但是牛奶委员会的某个人可能花了很多钱请一些老头来研究，如果你在牛奶中加入大量的调味料、色素和糖，

sentences.en: more kids will drink it. Yeah. Obviously now that's going to catch on the apple board is going to work out that if they make toffee apples they'll eat more as well.
sentences.zh: 更多的孩子会喝它。是的。显然，现在苹果委员会将会意识到，如果他们生产太妃糖苹果，他们也会吃得更多。

sentences.en: Do you know what I mean? For me, there isn't any need to flavor the milk.
sentences.zh: 你知道我的意思吗？对我来说，没有必要给牛奶调味。

sentences.en: Okay? There's sugar in everything. I know the ins and outs of those ingredients.
sentences.zh: 好的？万物皆有糖。我知道这些成分的来龙去脉。

sentences.en: It's in everything. Even the milk hasn't escaped the kind of modern-day problems.
sentences.zh: 它存在于一切事物中。就连牛奶也未能逃脱现代的问题。

sentences.en: There's our milk. There's our carton. In that is nearly as much sugar as one of your favorite cans of fizzy pop, and they are having two a day.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的牛奶。这是我们的纸箱。其中的糖分几乎与您最喜欢的一罐汽水一样多，而且他们每天喝两罐。

sentences.en: So, let me just show you. We've got one kid, here -- having, you know, eight tablespoons of sugar a day.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我向您展示一下。我们这里有一个孩子——你知道，每天吃八汤匙糖。

sentences.en: You know, there's your week. There's your month.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是你的一周。这是你的月份。

sentences.en: And I've taken the liberty of putting in just the five years of elementary school sugar, just from milk.
sentences.zh: 我冒昧地只添加了小学五年的糖，仅用牛奶。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know about you guys, but judging the circumstances, right, any judge in the whole world, would look at the statistics and the evidence, and they would find any government of old guilty of child abuse.
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道你们怎么想，但判断一下情况，对吧，全世界任何法官都会查看统计数据和证据，他们会发现任何旧政府犯有虐待儿童罪。

sentences.en: That's my belief. (Applause) (Applause ends) Now, if I came up here, and I wish I could come up here today
sentences.zh: 这就是我的信念。 （掌声）（掌声结束）现在，如果我来到这里，我希望我今天能来到这里

sentences.en: and hang a cure for AIDS or cancer, you'd be fighting and scrambling to get to me.
sentences.zh: 如果你有治疗艾滋病或癌症的方法，你就会争先恐后地来找我。

sentences.en: This, all this bad news, is preventable.
sentences.zh: 所有这些坏消息都是可以预防的。

sentences.en: That's the good news. It's very, very preventable.
sentences.zh: 这是个好消息。这是非常非常可以预防的。

sentences.en: So, let's just think about, we got a problem here, we need to reboot.
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们想想，我们这里遇到了问题，我们需要重新启动。

sentences.en: Okay so, in my world, what do we need to do?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么，在我的世界里，我们需要做什么呢？

sentences.en: Here is the thing, right, it cannot just come from one source.
sentences.zh: 事情是这样的，对吧，它不能只来自一个来源。

sentences.en: To reboot and make real tangible change, real change, so that I could look you in the white of the eyes and say, "In 10 years' time, the history of your children's lives, happiness -- and let's not forget, you're clever if you eat well,
sentences.zh: 重新启动并做出真正切实的改变，真正的改变，这样我就可以看着你的眼睛说，“十年后，你的孩子的生活史，幸福——我们不要忘记，如果你吃得好，你就很聪明，

sentences.en: you know you're going to live longer -- all of that stuff, it will look different. OK?"
sentences.zh: 你知道你会活得更久——所有这些，看起来都会有所不同。好吗？”

sentences.en: So, supermarkets. Where else do you shop so religiously?
sentences.zh: 那么，超市。你还能在哪里如此虔诚地购物呢？

sentences.en: Week in, week out. How much money do you spend, in your life, in a supermarket?
sentences.zh: 一周又一周。您一生中在超市花多少钱？

sentences.en: Love them. They just sell us what we want. All right.
sentences.zh: 爱他们。他们只是卖给我们我们想要的东西。好的。

sentences.en: They owe us to put a food ambassador in every major supermarket.
sentences.zh: 他们欠我们在每个主要超市都安排一名食品大使。

sentences.en: They need to help us shop. They need to show us how to cook quick, tasty, seasonal meals for people that are busy.
sentences.zh: 他们需要帮助我们购物。他们需要向我们展示如何为忙碌的人们烹饪快速、美味的时令菜肴。

sentences.en: This is not expensive. It is done in some, and it needs to be done across the board in America soon, and quick.
sentences.zh: 这并不贵。一些国家已经这样做了，而且美国需要尽快、快速地全面这样做。

sentences.en: The big brands, you know, the food brands, need to put food education at the heart of their businesses.
sentences.zh: 大品牌，你知道，食品品牌，需要将食品教育置于其业务的核心。

sentences.en: I know, easier said than done. It's the future. It's the only way.
sentences.zh: 我知道，说起来容易做起来难。这是未来。这是唯一的办法。

sentences.en: Fast food. With the fast-food industry you know, it's very competitive.
sentences.zh: 快餐。你知道，快餐行业竞争非常激烈。

sentences.en: I've had loads of secret papers and dealings with fast food restaurants.
sentences.zh: 我有大量的秘密文件和与快餐店的交易。

sentences.en: I know how they do it. I mean, basically they've weaned us on to these hits of sugar, salt and fat, and x, y, and z, and everyone loves them, right?
sentences.zh: 我知道他们是怎么做的。我的意思是，基本上他们已经让我们摆脱了糖、盐和脂肪以及 x、y 和 z 的束缚，每个人都喜欢它们，对吗？

sentences.en: So, these guys are going to be part of the solution.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些人将成为解决方案的一部分。

sentences.en: But we need to get the government to work with all of the fast food purveyors and the restaurant industry, and over a five, six, seven year period wean of us off the extreme amounts of fat, sugar and all the other non-food ingredients.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要让政府与所有快餐供应商和餐饮业合作，在五、六、七年的时间内让我们戒掉过量的脂肪、糖和所有其他非食品成分。

sentences.en: Now, also, back to the sort of big brands: labeling, I said earlier, is an absolute farce and has got to be sorted.
sentences.zh: 现在，又回到大品牌的问题上：我之前说过，标签绝对是一场闹剧，必须进行分类。

sentences.en: OK, school. Obviously, in schools, we owe it to them to make sure those 180 days of the year, from that little precious age of four, until 18, 20, 24, whatever, they need to be cooked proper, fresh food
sentences.zh: 好的，学校。显然，在学校里，我们有责任确保一年中的 180 天，从四岁那宝贵的小年纪，到 18、20、24 岁，无论如何，他们需要正确烹饪新鲜的食物

sentences.en: from local growers on site, OK? There needs to be a new standard of fresh, proper food for your children, yeah?
sentences.zh: 来自现场当地种植者，好吗？需要为您的孩子制定新鲜、适当食物的新标准，是吗？

sentences.en: (Applause) Under the circumstances, it's profoundly important that every single American child leaves school knowing how to cook 10 recipes
sentences.zh: （掌声）在这种情况下，让每个美国孩子离开学校时都知道如何烹饪 10 种食谱是非常重要的

sentences.en: that will save their life. Life skills. (Applause) That means that they can be students, young parents, and be able to sort of duck and dive around the basics of cooking,
sentences.zh: 这将挽救他们的生命。生活技能。 （掌声）这意味着他们可以是学生、年轻的父母，能够快速掌握烹饪的基本知识，

sentences.en: no matter what recession hits them next time.
sentences.zh: 无论下次经济衰退如何打击他们。

sentences.en: If you can cook, recession money doesn't matter.
sentences.zh: 如果你会做饭，经济衰退的钱就不重要了。

sentences.en: If you can cook, time doesn't matter. The workplace, we haven't really talked about it.
sentences.zh: 如果你会做饭，时间就不是问题。职场，我们还没有真正讨论过。

sentences.en: You know, it's now time for corporate responsibility to really look at what they feed or make available to their staff.
sentences.zh: 你知道，现在是企业责任真正审视他们为员工提供什么或提供什么的时候了。

sentences.en: The staff are the moms and dads of America's children.
sentences.zh: 工作人员是美国孩子们的妈妈和爸爸。

sentences.en: Marissa, her father died in her hand, I think she'd be quite happy if corporate America could start feeding their staff properly.
sentences.zh: 玛丽莎，她的父亲死在她手里，我想如果美国企业界能够开​​始为员工提供适当的食物，她会很高兴。

sentences.en: Definitely they shouldn't be left out. Let's go back to the home.
sentences.zh: 绝对不应该将他们排除在外。我们回家吧。

sentences.en: Now, look, if we do all this stuff, and we can, it's so achievable.
sentences.zh: 现在，看，如果我们做所有这些事情，而且我们可以，这是可以实现的。

sentences.en: You can care and be commercial. Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 你可以关心并商业化。绝对地。

sentences.en: But the home needs to start passing on cooking again, for sure.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，家里需要重新开始传承烹饪。

sentences.en: For sure, pass it on as a philosophy. And for me, it's quite romantic, but it's about if one person teaches three people how to cook something, and they teach three of their mates, that only has to repeat itself 25 times,
sentences.zh: 当然，将其作为一种哲学传递下去。对我来说，这很浪漫，但如果一个人教三个人如何做饭，然后他们教三个人的伴侣，这只需要重复25次，

sentences.en: and that's the whole population of America.
sentences.zh: 这就是美国的全部人口。

sentences.en: Romantic, yes, but most importantly, it's about trying to get people to realize that every one of your individual efforts makes a difference.
sentences.zh: 浪漫，是的，但最重要的是，它是为了让人们意识到你的每一项个人努力都会产生影响。

sentences.en: We've got to put back what's been lost. Huntington's Kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把失去的东西找回来。亨廷顿的厨房。

sentences.en: Huntington, where I made this program, we've got this prime-time program that hopefully will inspire people to really get on this change.
sentences.zh: 亨廷顿，我在那里制作了这个节目，我们有这个黄金时段节目，希望能够激励人们真正参与这一变革。

sentences.en: I truly believe that change will happen.
sentences.zh: 我坚信改变将会发生。

sentences.en: Huntington's Kitchen. I work with a community.
sentences.zh: 亨廷顿的厨房。我与社区合作。

sentences.en: I worked in the schools. I found local sustainable funding to get every single school in the area from the junk, onto the fresh food: six-and-a-half grand per school.
sentences.zh: 我在学校工作。我找到了当地的可持续资金，让该地区的每所学校摆脱垃圾，转向新鲜食品：每所学校六英镑半。

sentences.en: (Applause) That's all it takes, six-and-a-half grand per school.
sentences.zh: （掌声）这就够了，每所学校六块半。

sentences.en: The Kitchen is 25 grand a month. Okay? This can do 5,000 people a year, which is 10 percent of their population, and it's people on people.
sentences.zh: 厨房每月25格兰特。好的？每年可以帮助 5,000 人，占其人口的 10%，而且是人与人之间的关系。

sentences.en: You know, it's local cooks teaching local people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是当地厨师教当地人的。

sentences.en: It's free cooking lessons, guys, in the Main Street.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，这是在大街上的免费烹饪课。

sentences.en: This is real, tangible change, real, tangible change.
sentences.zh: 这是真实的、看得见的变化，真实的、看得见的变化。

sentences.en: Around America, if we just look back now, there is plenty of wonderful things going on.
sentences.zh: 在美国各地，如果我们现在回头看，就会发现很多美好的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: There is plenty of beautiful things going on.
sentences.zh: 有很多美好的事情正在发生。

sentences.en: There are angels around America doing great things in schools -- farm-to-school set-ups, garden set-ups, education -- there are amazing people doing this already.
sentences.zh: 美国各地都有天使在学校里做着伟大的事情——从农场到学校的设置、花园的设置、教育——已经有一些了不起的人在这样做了。

sentences.en: The problem is they all want to roll out what they're doing to the next school, but there's no cash.
sentences.zh: 问题是他们都想将他们正在做的事情推广到下一所学校，但没有现金。

sentences.en: We need to recognize the experts and the angels quickly, identify them, and allow them to easily find the resource to keep rolling out what they're already doing, and doing well.
sentences.zh: 我们需要快速识别专家和天使，识别他们，并让他们轻松找到资源，继续推出他们已经在做的事情，并且做得很好。

sentences.en: Businesses of America need to support Mrs. Obama to do the things that she wants to do.
sentences.zh: 美国企业需要支持奥巴马夫人做她想做的事情。

sentences.en: (Applause) And look, I know it's weird having an English person standing here before you talking about all this.
sentences.zh: （掌声）听着，我知道在你谈论这一切之前有一个英国人站在这里很奇怪。

sentences.en: All I can say is: I care. I'm a father, and I love this country.
sentences.zh: 我只能说：我在乎。我是一名父亲，我爱这个国家。

sentences.en: And I believe truly, actually, that if change can be made in this country, beautiful things will happen around the world.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我坚信，如果这个国家能够做出改变，世界各地就会发生美好的事情。

sentences.en: If America does it, other people will follow.
sentences.zh: 如果美国这样做，其他国家也会效仿。

sentences.en: It's incredibly important. (Audience) Yeah!
sentences.zh: 这非常重要。 （观众）是啊！

sentences.en: (Applause) When I was in Huntington, trying to get a few things to work when they weren't, I thought "If I had a magic wand, what would I do?"
sentences.zh: （掌声）当我在亨廷顿时，我试图让一些事情发挥作用，但事实并非如此，我想：“如果我有一根魔杖，我会做什么？”

sentences.en: And I thought, "You know what? I'd just love to be put in front of some of the most amazing movers and shakers in America."
sentences.zh: 我想，“你知道吗？我很乐意站在美国一些最令人惊叹的影响力人物面前。”

sentences.en: And a month later, TED phoned me up and gave me this award.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，TED 打电话给我并授予了我这个奖项。

sentences.en: I'm here. So, my wish. Dyslexic, so I'm a bit slow.
sentences.zh: 我在这儿。那么，我的愿望。我有诵读困难，所以我的反应有点慢。

sentences.en: My wish is for you to help a strong, sustainable movement to educate every child about food,
sentences.zh: 我希望您能够帮助发起一场强有力的、可持续的运动，教育每个孩子关于食物的知识，

sentences.en: to inspire families to cook again, and to empower people everywhere to fight obesity.
sentences.zh: 激励家庭重新做饭，并帮助世界各地的人们对抗肥胖。

sentences.en: (Applause) Thank you. (Applause continues)
sentences.zh: （鼓掌）谢谢。 （掌声继续）
